user.title: Créer un capteur de lumière du jour pour une pièce
user.description: Configure the room and the source entities used to estimate its natural daylight. Window details are entered on the next step.

data_description.name: A friendly name for this room, for example Living Room or Kitchen.
data_description.outside_illuminance: A sensor with the Illuminance device class that represents the current outdoor light level in lux. This can be a physical outdoor lux sensor or an estimated source such as the Illuminance integration.
data_description.sun_entity: A Home Assistant Sun entity that exposes the current solar azimuth and elevation. The standard Sun integration normally provides sun.sun.
data_description.floor_area: The approximate internal floor area of the room in square metres. Length × width is usually sufficient; exact architectural precision is not required.
data_description.window_count: How many separate external windows, glazed doors, or other glazed openings contribute daylight to this room.
data_description.indoor_illuminance: Optional illuminance sensors inside the room. Their readings only provide a bounded correction to the calculated estimate, so local bright or dark spots cannot dominate it.
data_description.artificial_lights: Select lights that materially affect the chosen indoor illuminance sensors. Indoor sensor correction is ignored whenever any selected light is on.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure room daylight
reconfigure.description: Update the daylight source, Sun entity, room size, or windows. Indoor illuminance sensors and artificial-light exclusions can be changed from Configure / Options.

data_description.outside_illuminance: A sensor with the Illuminance device class that represents the current outdoor light level in lux.
data_description.sun_entity: A Home Assistant Sun entity exposing solar azimuth and elevation.
data_description.floor_area: Approximate internal floor area in square metres.
data_description.window_count: Changing this value lets you add or remove configured windows during the following steps.

window.title: Fenêtre {window_number} sur {window_total}
window.description: Enter one external glazed opening. Measure the approximate glazed opening rather than the wall. Azimuth is the compass direction the window faces outwards: North 0°, East 90°, South 180°, West 270°. A phone compass can be used if needed.

data_description.width: Approximate width of the glazed opening in metres. For French or patio doors, measure the complete glazed doorway.
data_description.height: Approximate height of the glazed opening in metres.
data_description.azimuth: Compass bearing in degrees for the direction this window faces outwards. North = 0°, East = 90°, South = 180°, West = 270°.
data_description.cover_entity: Optional cover, binary sensor, or input boolean representing whether this opening is covered. A fully closed cover, or an on binary/input boolean, excludes this window from the calculation.

error.positive_number: Enter a number greater than zero.
error.azimuth_range: Enter an azimuth from 0° up to, but not including, 360°.

abort.already_configured: A room with this name is already configured.

init.title: Room Daylight options
init.description: Manage optional indoor sensor correction and the artificial lights that temporarily disable it.

data_description.indoor_illuminance: Select one or more illuminance sensors in this room. These readings reinforce the model but are deliberately prevented from overriding it completely.
data_description.artificial_lights: Select lights that materially affect those sensors. When any selected light is on, indoor readings are ignored so artificial light is not mistaken for daylight.
